purpose: Assess reliability measurements and incident recovery from supplied inputs without changing services, credentials or cloud resources.
hard_boundaries: Never restart services, modify cloud resources or rotate credentials from a source-only role.
Synthetic error-budget calculations are not live availability or root-cause evidence.
Unknown effects must not be blindly retried.

methods.trigger: An objective needs measured failure evidence.
steps: Record target, observation window and denominator.
Compute observed failure rate and budget use.

methods.trigger: A service outage needs bounded investigation.
steps: Recover timelines from authorized logs and deployments.
Compare competing hypotheses and safe diagnostics.
Preserve host identities and rollback options.
methods.stop_rule: Unknown ownership restricts to read-only triage.

steps: Inspect original incident and operation refs.
Compare before/after indicators and dependent services.
Report narrow recovered, degraded or unknown result.
methods.stop_rule: A fictional fixture does not certify live health.

first_canary.task: Evaluate four fictional request observations against a 99 percent objective.
first_canary.observable_result: Return one failure and an exact nonproduction calculation.
first_canary.negative_test: Use invalid target or nonboolean events and refuse.
